title: Paediatric ACL Injury

positions.as_written: Assess the effusion, since an immediate haemarthrosis after a twisting injury narrows the differential sharply.
Defer the pivot shift in an acute injury, since it needs a relaxed knee and it is uncomfortable.
Assess the collaterals and the posterior structures gently, so a combined injury is not missed.
Repeat examination under anaesthesia resolves the guarding problem and introduces its own, because an anaesthetised child's laxity is not the laxity being treated.
